breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.001 with 600 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.5.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim: 'Use dt=0.001 with 600 time steps.' This gives T=0.6, not T=0.5. The ground truth corrects this to 500 steps (dt=0.001 × 500 = 0.5). The agent did not fix the inconsistency.
